source.author: verg
source.text: hinc mater cultrix Cybeli Corybantiaque aera Idaeumque nemus; hinc fida silentia sacris, et iuncti currum dominae subiere leones.
source.text_original: hinc mater cultrix Cybeli Corybantiaque aera / Idaeumque nemus; hinc fida silentia sacris, / et iuncti currum dominae subiere leones.
source.text_english: From here comes the mother, worshipper of Cybele, and the Corybantic cymbals and the Idaean grove; from here come the faithful silences of the rites, and the yoked lions have submitted their necks to the chariot of their mistress.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: hinc fida silentia sacris instituta sunt ab hominibus callidis, ne sciat populus quid colat.
reuse.text_original: hinc fida silentia sacris instituta sunt ab hominibus callidis, ne sciat populus quid colat.
reuse.text_english: Hence trustworthy silence was established for the rites by shrewd men, so that the people might not know what they worship.
